description.en: Judgement between anterior (1–2 o'clock) and posterior (5–6 o'clock) myotomy orientation informed by patient anatomy and prior interventions.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for myotomy orientation selection but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs myotomy orientation selection independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches myotomy orientation selection to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
